contents.text: What was Nasdaq's net cash provided by operating activities in 2025?

Nasdaq's net cash provided by operating activities in 2025 was $2,255 million. (Source: NDAQ-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements and PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations)
